plan.description: Fix boltons.listutils.BarrelList indexing and insertion at either boundary to match built-in list behavior, including after data has split across internal sublists.
plan.hypothesis: Boundary indexing and insertion logic in BarrelList.__getitem__/insert mishandles cases where data has split across sublists.
plan.next_action: Locate and reproduce one failure in BarrelList boundary indexing or insertion.

plan.description: Fix boltons.listutils.BarrelList.pop() so empty tail sublists do not cause errors.
plan.hypothesis: pop() fails when the last internal sublist is empty.
plan.next_action: Locate and reproduce BarreList.pop() failure with an empty tail sublist.

plan.description: Fix boltons.setutils.IndexedSet to preserve ordering and indexes after bulk difference and intersection updates, without repeated full compactions on large removals.
plan.hypothesis: Bulk difference_update/intersection_update invalidate indexes or trigger repeated O(n) compactions.
plan.next_action: Locate and reproduce IndexedSet ordering/index failure after a bulk difference or intersection update.
